title: BaselineRunRecord
description: Schema for a single baseline run record in the PROJ-036 prompt regression harness. Each record captures one LLM invocation with evaluation scores for a specific agent/prompt combination.

agent_name.description: Target agent identifier matching the agent definition filename without extension.

prompt_id.description: Canonical prompt identifier from the prompt YAML file. Format: P-{AGENT_PREFIX}-{NNN}

run_index.description: Run sequence number within the N=30 set for this agent/prompt pair. 1-indexed.

model_version.description: Exact Anthropic API model identifier used for the agent invocation. Must not use alias strings.

judge_model_version.description: Exact model identifier used for LLM-as-Judge evaluation (may differ from agent invocation model).

capture_timestamp_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp at run initiation.

capture_session_id.description: Session-level identifier shared across all runs in a single capture invocation.

agent_definition_git_hash.description: Full or short git commit hash of the agent definition file at capture time.

agent_definition_path.description: Repo-relative path to the agent definition file. Used with git_hash for exact version identification.

prompt_git_hash.description: Full or short git commit hash of the prompt YAML file at capture time.

prompt_file_path.description: Repo-relative path to the prompt YAML file containing this prompt's definition.

temperature.description: Temperature parameter used for the LLM invocation. Baseline captures MUST use temperature=1.0. Smoke mode (temperature=0) is excluded from baseline data.

raw_output.description: Complete unmodified LLM output text. Null only if api_error is non-null (failed invocation).

output_token_count.description: Token count of raw_output as reported by the API response. Null if api_error is non-null.

input_token_count.description: Token count of the full prompt sent to the API (system + user message combined). Null if api_error is non-null.

latency_ms.description: Wall-clock API call latency in milliseconds from request send to response receipt. Null if api_error is non-null.

api_error.description: Error message if the API call failed, null if successful. Runs with api_error non-null are excluded from statistical analysis.

scores.description: Quality scores per evaluation dimension and weighted composite. Uses SSOT 6-dimension weighted composite from quality-enforcement.md.

completeness.description: Completeness dimension score (weight 0.20). Null if evaluation_error is non-null.

internal_consistency.description: Internal consistency dimension score (weight 0.20). Null if evaluation_error is non-null.

methodological_rigor.description: Methodological rigor dimension score (weight 0.20). Null if evaluation_error is non-null.

evidence_quality.description: Evidence quality dimension score (weight 0.15). Null if evaluation_error is non-null.

actionability.description: Actionability dimension score (weight 0.15). Null if evaluation_error is non-null.

traceability.description: Traceability dimension score (weight 0.10). Null if evaluation_error is non-null.

weighted_composite.description: Weighted composite score: (completeness*0.20 + internal_consistency*0.20 + methodological_rigor*0.20 + evidence_quality*0.15 + actionability*0.15 + traceability*0.10). Pass threshold >= 0.92. Null if evaluation_error is non-null.

evaluation_method.description: Evaluation mechanism used to produce scores.

evaluation_error.description: Error message if the evaluation pipeline failed, null if successful. Runs with evaluation_error non-null have null scores but may still have valid raw_output.

expected_behaviors_met.description: Per-behavior pass/fail assessment. Keys are behavior IDs from the prompt definition (e.g., B-001). Values are booleans or null if assessment was not performed.

behaviors_met_count.description: Count of expected behaviors that were observed as true in expected_behaviors_met.

behaviors_total_count.description: Total number of expected behaviors defined for this prompt.

behaviors_pass_rate.description: Fraction of expected behaviors met: behaviors_met_count / behaviors_total_count. Null if behaviors_total_count is 0.

mr_results.description: Metamorphic relation check results. Null for Phase A-B captures (MR layer not yet active). Required for Phase D+ captures.

MR-001_paraphrase_delta.description: Score delta between original and paraphrased prompt invocations. Pass threshold: abs(delta) <= 0.05.

MR-002_negation_handled.description: Whether the agent correctly handled a negated version of the prompt.

MR-003_irrelevant_context_delta.description: Score delta when irrelevant context is appended to the prompt. Pass threshold: abs(delta) <= 0.05.

MR-004_formatting_perturbation_delta.description: Score delta under formatting perturbation (whitespace, markdown changes). Pass threshold: abs(delta) <= 0.05.

MR-005_language_roundtrip_delta.description: Score delta for prompt translated to French then back to English. Pass threshold: abs(delta) <= 0.05.

metadata.description: Optional additional metadata for this run. Free-form extension point.
